name: TrueLayer
label: TrueLayer — Payments API v3 + Data API v3
description: Official TrueLayer Payments API v3 + Data API v3 (recommended for new data integrations; Data v1 remains documented separately). Docs: https://docs.truelayer.com/docs/enable-your-users-to-connect-their-bank-account. auth_link = POST /v3/data-connections. accounts_list = GET /v3/connected-accounts with Connection-Id. transactions_list = GET /v3/connected-accounts/{account_id}/transactions/requests/{request_id} (v3 is async; pass request_id from a prior create-request). Payments stay /v3/payments. UK only for Data v3. Consent receipts required. Verify Tl-Signature on BPMN ingress. Sandbox: api.truelayer-sandbox.com.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for TrueLayer. Secrets never on this port.

schema.label: Operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: auth_link | accounts_list | transactions_list | payment_create | payment_get | trigger. Data ops are Data API v3. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not HTTP.

schema.label: Id
schema.description: Resource id when the path uses {id}.

schema.label: Connection Id
schema.description: Data API v3 Connection-Id header. Overrides config connection_id for accounts_list / transactions_list.

schema.label: Request Id
schema.description: Data API v3 transactions request id. Required for transactions_list GET .../transactions/requests/{request_id}.

schema.label: Account Id
schema.description: Connected-account id for transactions_list path {account_id}.

schema.label: user
schema.description: Data API v3 user {id} for auth_link POST /v3/data-connections. Example: {"id":"user-123"}. https://docs.truelayer.com/docs/create-a-data-connection

schema.label: user_consent
schema.description: auth_link user_consent {agreed, timestamp}. Example: {"agreed":true}.

schema.label: hosted_page
schema.description: auth_link hosted_page {return_uri, language}. Example: {"return_uri":"https://example.com/cb"}.

schema.label: authorization_flow
schema.description: auth_link authorization_flow {provider_selection, redirect}. Official Data Connections body.

schema.label: provider_selection
schema.description: auth_link provider_selection {type, filter}. Example: {"type":"user_selected"}.

schema.label: data_access_type
schema.description: auth_link. EXACT: ONETIME | RECURRING. Example: ONETIME.

schema.label: scopes
schema.description: auth_link scopes. Example: ["accounts","transactions","balance"].

schema.label: cursor
schema.description: Query-string parameter `cursor` for operation: accounts_list.

schema.label: type
schema.description: Query-string parameter `type` for operation: accounts_list.

schema.label: amount_in_minor
schema.description: payment_create amount in minor units. Example: 100 = 1.00 GBP.

schema.label: currency
schema.description: payment_create ISO 4217. Example: GBP.

schema.label: payment_method
schema.description: payment_create payment_method {type, provider_selection, beneficiary}. Required. https://docs.truelayer.com/docs/create-a-payment

schema.label: signing_key_id
schema.description: KID for Tl-Signature on Payments v3 POSTs. Example: key-id-from-console.

schema.label: signing_private_key
schema.description: ES512 private key PEM used to sign Payments v3 POSTs (Tl-Signature). Prefer config secret. Example: -----BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY-----…

schema.label: environment
schema.description: API host environment. EXACT: sandbox | production. sandbox→api.truelayer-sandbox.com; production→api.truelayer.com. Example: sandbox.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: ok on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: Http Status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. Never secrets or PAN.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb to run. EXACT: auth_link | accounts_list | transactions_list | payment_create | payment_get | trigger. Default auth_link = POST /v3/data-connections. Data list ops require config/input connection_id (Connection-Id header). operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
configurationParameters.description: TrueLayer bearer access token minted outside StudioQuack (Console client_id/client_secret). Never INPUT, never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Signing Key Id
configurationParameters.description: KID required in Tl-Signature for Payments v3. From TrueLayer Console signing keys.

configurationParameters.label: Signing Private Key
configurationParameters.description: ES512 private key to sign all Payments v3 POSTs (Tl-Signature). Never log.

configurationParameters.label: Environment
configurationParameters.description: api.truelayer-sandbox.com (sandbox) vs api.truelayer.com (production). Select host environment; set matching access_token.

configurationParameters.label: Connection Id
configurationParameters.description: Data API v3 Connection-Id header. Returned by POST /v3/data-connections after the user authorises. Required for accounts_list and transactions_list. Overridable on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
